sasha: Postmortem posted: <link-to-postmortem>. Need owners and Jira tickets for the open action items. Quick ask: who can own these and confirm target dates?

Actions:
1) A1 — fix cache eviction race (regression risk)
2) A2 — add deterministic regression test & CI job
3) A3 — update incident runbook + oncall playbook

Proposed deadlines: A1: 2025-05-12, A2: 2025-05-19, A3: 2025-05-26

sasha: Suggested RACI (initial): A1 R: ?, A: Platform Eng (derek?), C: infra, I: SRE; A2 R: ?, A: QA (maria?), C: eng, I: product; A3 R: ?, A: SRE (aj?), C: docs, I: all oncall

derek: I can take A1 (R). Will file a ticket now.
derek: Filed INF-2819 for A1 and linked in the postmortem. ETA 2025-05-11 for a patch.
maria: I'll own A2 (R). I need a quick convo on which test infra to use — do we want a nightly or PR-gated job?
aj: I'll own A3 (R). I'll draft the runbook updates and put together an ops checklist. Need a reviewer for oncall steps.

lee: For A1, can we tag it under recurring-pattern:cache-eviction so we can query similar previous incidents? I think we've seen this ~3x in the last 6 months.

olivia: Quick RACI suggestion: A1: R=derek, A=sasha, C=lee,maria, I=team-eng; A2: R=maria, A=olivia, C=qa, I=product; A3: R=aj, A=aj, C=docs, I=oncall. Fine to iterate.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up check in 7 days for tickets INF-2819, INF-2820, INF-2821

derek: Noted. I'll add test case notes to INF-2819 so QA can correlate.
maria: Filing INF-2820 for A2, setting it to Blocker: false, depends on INF-2819 for repro script. ETA 2025-05-18.
aj: INF-2821 created for A3. Draft runbook in the ticket and pinging @olivia for review.

sasha: Thanks — final asks: 1) add Jira links to the postmortem doc (done by owner), 2) update the RACI table in the postmortem page, 3) tag tickets with recurring-pattern=cache-eviction.

olivia: I'll own the postmortem RACI update and will publish by EOD tomorrow.

lee: Also proposing a quarterly rollup item to see if batching or KV cache changes reduce recurrence — adding a note to INF-2821.

sasha: OK schedule: quick sync next Wed 10:30am to validate progress, ops-bot will send calendar invite. If any owner needs to shift deadlines ping here. :thumbsup:

maria: ack
derek: ack
aj: ack

ops-bot: Calendar invite sent: Postmortem follow-up sync — 2025-05-07 10:30am

sasha: Closing thread for now, will reopen if blockers surface. Please update tickets and postmortem when you make changes. Thanks all!
